title: Can't connect to dash pod anymore, need to change dash pod
symptom: AAPS stopped working with Dash pods after connecting to Android Car for a Zoom meeting and GPS. The user had to sync a new pod after returning home. The issue recurred when using Android Car again.
cause: The thread suggests it is a Bluetooth stack issue of the phone, possibly caused by a connected Bluetooth device.
fix: The suggested fix is to replace the phone or try a factory reset. The user also tried restarting the phone, clearing cache and data, and restarting Bluetooth, but these did not work.
evidence_quote: this BT stack issue of your phone. AAPS cannot do anything with this issue. Replace the phone or try factory reset
